name: Personal Knowledge
description: Use a local Obsidian vault as verified, time-aware long-term context: scoped retrieval, guarded write-back, and project routing.
author: minih-git

en.name: Personal Knowledge
en.description: Use a local Obsidian vault as verified, time-aware long-term context: scoped retrieval, guarded write-back, and project routing.
en.safetyNotes: Spawns a local Node MCP process that reads and writes inside the Obsidian vault you configure (default ~/Documents/Knowledge). Writes are guarded: dry-run by default, updates require the note's current SHA-256, likely credentials are rejected, changes are written atomically and backed up. Nothing leaves the machine. Configure the vault path and a private mapping file in the plugin settings.

zh-CN.name: Personal Knowledge
zh-CN.description: 把本地 Obsidian 知识库当作经过校验、带时效的长期上下文：按仓库与主题加载、检索、读取带哈希保护的笔记并安全回写。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 会启动一个本地 Node MCP 进程，只在你配置的 Obsidian 知识库（默认 ~/Documents/Knowledge）内读写。写入有防护：默认 dry-run，更新需要笔记当前 SHA-256，拒绝疑似凭据，原子写入并自动备份。数据不出本机。请在插件设置里配置库路径与私有映射文件。

skills.name: obsidian-knowledge
skills.description: Retrieve and maintain the user's Obsidian knowledge when work depends on existing projects, preferences, decisions, or infrastructure. Save confirmed durable changes; skip self-contained tasks that need no prior context.

skills.name: obsidian-project-knowledge
skills.description: Extract repository knowledge into structured Obsidian project notes. Use when the user wants to turn a codebase, docs folder, README, architecture, features, deployment flow, or operations knowledge into reusable Obsidian notes, MOCs, or linked project knowledge pages.

settings.title: 知识库路径（Vault path）
settings.description: Obsidian vault 的绝对路径，默认 ~/Documents/Knowledge。留空使用默认值。

settings.title: 私有映射文件（Mapping file）
settings.description: repo-map 配置的绝对路径：项目路由、主题路由、默认笔记。留空则使用插件自带的空模板，即不做项目路由。

settings.title: 只读模式（Read-only）
settings.description: 开启后 MCP 只读不写：knowledge_write 的 dry-run 仍可用，真实写入会被拒绝。
